name: jpt-4b
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B: 8 full GQA layers (kv heads 4, head_dim 256) and 24 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-25. A finetune of Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 4.539 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence cc-by-nc-4.0, repo created 2026-09-24. Caveats: this is a decision model (per-option probabilities in one forward pass), so it is ranked on the Decision Index and excluded from the worth-running text ranking. Licence is CC-BY-NC-4.0 (non-commercial). One printed row REGRESSES: ERQA 0.455 vs base 0.463 - recorded in the notes rather than the benchmarks because it is a loss. JevBench/typed-decisions rows are the vendor's own suite; ScreenSpot-v2 and Screen2Words are public.
